T: Experience it. Enjoy it. Just don't fall for it.
D: In 1973 a 15-year-old writer talks his way onto a rock band's tour for Rolling Stone and finds out what the road costs everyone on it.
P: Serve the burgers when Russell shouts that he's a golden god from the Topeka roof.
S: Soy-glazed tofu cutlets, what Elaine made the night Anita left.

Brush the tofu slices with the soy sauce. Coat in flour, egg, then panko. Shallow-fry in the oil, turning, until crisp and golden. Stir the dill and a squeeze of lemon into the mayo and serve with lemon wedges.
Toasted club of turkey, bacon and fried egg, everything Elaine banned.

Fry the bacon until crisp, then fry the eggs in the fat until just set. Toast and butter the bread. Layer toast, mayo, lettuce, tomato and bacon, then toast, cheese and egg, then a final slice. Pin with toothpicks and cut into triangles.
M: Cheeseburgers with fries, served poolside in Topeka.

Bake the fries at 220C until crisp. Shape the mince into 8 thin patties and season well. Sear the patties on a very hot grill, 2 minutes a side, laying cheese on each after the flip. Toast the buns and stack 2 patties in each with onion, pickles, sauce and mustard. Serve with the fries.
Riot House room service steak Diane
Steak Diane with fries from room service, the band's tab.

Bake the fries at 220C until golden. Sear the seasoned steaks in half the butter, 3 minutes a side, then rest. Fry the mushrooms and garlic in the rest of the butter, then add the brandy and let it bubble off. Stir in the Worcestershire, mustard and cream and simmer until glossy. Spoon the sauce over the steaks, scatter with parsley and serve with chips.
W: Whole orange and almond cake. Penny finally makes it to Morocco.

Simmer the whole oranges in water until very soft, then cool and blitz to a puree, skins and all. Beat the eggs and sugar until thick, then fold in the almond meal, baking powder and orange puree. Pour into a lined 22cm tin and bake at 170C until set. Stir the honey through the yoghurt and serve with the cake and pistachios.
K: Fifty bucks and a case of beer
Ice-cold lager in a bucket with lime wedges.
Fill a bucket with ice and bury the bottles in it. Serve with lime wedges on the side.
